build_byte_bpe_encoder: build a ByteBPE encoder using a SentencePiece model to tokenize text with byte-level subword encoding
encode_text_with_byte_bpe: encode a string using ByteBPE by byte-encoding it then applying SentencePiece subword tokenization
decode_byte_bpe_tokens: decode a ByteBPE-encoded string back to the original text using the static decode method
configure_byte_bpe_model: configure a ByteBpeConfig dataclass with a SentencePiece model path for ByteBPE initialization
register_byte_bpe_encoder: register the ByteBPE encoder under the name byte_bpe in the fairseq BPE registry
